notes.rule: sum of the five fund columns of the fund-type table (personal gemel for compensation and severance, study funds, investment gemel, child savings, central severance fund); the printed total column ('סך הכל') equals this sum at every balance date and window (checked), so it is not added again. Assets: the all-members row (active + inactive). Deposits: 'תקבולים מדמי גמולים' (one-time deposits are a separate row and are not added).

company level from the financial statements (the company manages only provident funds: its single segment). fees = 'הכנסות מדמי ניהול'; sm = 'עמלות שיווק והפצה' (agent commissions net of the change in deferred acquisition costs, distribution commissions); ga = 'הוצאות הנהלה וכלליות' + 'הוצאות בגין קבלת שירותים ושאילת עובדים מהחברה האם' (the company has no payroll: its staff and services are charged by the parent, so these are its operating costs other than S&M). Not included: finance and investment income/expense, tax.
